text: {"lessons":["A loss on Stock D alone is not a reason to sell; I should decide based on my outlook and overall plan, not my average cost.","My account rose after I bought Stocks A and B, but one period is not enough to show those trades caused the gain; I should judge decisions over time.","I want to grow savings for an apartment, so I should invest steadily, keep an appropriate mix of holdings and cash, and avoid rushed trades."]}
